description: This PHP class 'PredefinedChart' defines various query-generating methods for predefined charts in SuiteCRM, including sales pipeline, lead source outcomes, monthly outcomes, lead source pipeline, module usage, and custom chart queries.

classes.name: PredefinedChart
classes.description: Defines methods to generate SQL queries for various predefined charts within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: predefinedChartQuery
methods.description: Routes the chart request to the appropriate specific query method based on chart type.

methods.name: pipelineBySalesStageQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to retrieve opportunities grouped by sales stage within a date range, considering user preferences.

methods.name: leadSourceByOutcomeQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL to analyze opportunities by lead source and outcome, with filtering options.

methods.name: outcomeByMonthQuery
methods.description: Creates a SQL query summarizing opportunities by sales stage and month/year.

methods.name: pipelineByLeadSourceQuery
methods.description: Prepares SQL to analyze opportunities by lead source and sales stage, filtered by user and date preferences.

methods.name: myModuleUsageLast30Days
methods.description: Gets SQL for tracking user module activity over the last 30 days.

methods.name: customChartQuery
methods.description: Attempts to load a custom PHP file for specific chart queries if it exists.
